episode_row: fable5 audit latent batch (incl. E3 missed-pick alert never implemented; platoon_hr NaN in live inference; leaky shadow feature; no-games thrash)

commits.subject: fix(cli): default `bts schedule` date to Eastern, not UTC
commits.body:
UTC rolls over 4-5h ahead of ET, so a scheduler restart (deploy/OOM/watchdog)
between ~8pm and midnight ET initialized run_day for tomorrow and abandoned
tonight's result polling + late-slate delivery. Adds a patchable module-level
_today_et() seam and points schedule at it. (audit O2)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: fix(scheduler): watchdog-feed the doubleheader game-2 recheck sleep
commits.body:
The DH game-2 recheck loop used a bare time.sleep(dh_recheck_min*60) (15min
default, up to 10x): two un-pinged sleeps hit WatchdogSec=1800 → SIGABRT
crash-loop on any unlocked-pick day with a doubleheader. Now mirrors the
result-poll wait: SLEEPING heartbeat + sleeping_until + _watchdog_ping_sleep,
restoring RUNNING after. Adds an AST guard test that fails on ANY unwrapped
time.sleep in scheduler.py (this bug class shipped 5 times). (audit O1)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: fix(health): measure contest staleness in settled picks, not calendar days
commits.body:
contest_state.check used gap = (latest_resolved - source_date).days, so any
multi-day off-day stretch (All-Star break, league off-days) inflated the gap and
fired a deterministic false CRITICAL on the first day back — though the contest
was only one settlement behind. Now counts settled production picks newer than
source_date (off-days have no picks): exactly 1 == expected overnight lag (INFO),
>= 2 == genuine week-long-freeze staleness (CRITICAL). Pick path still freezes
conservatively on any gap. Updated two tests whose single-pick fixtures encoded
the old calendar-day behavior. (audit H2)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: fix(health): surface a crashing check as CRITICAL, not silence
commits.body:
_safe_run swallowed any check exception and returned [] — a check that raised
every run produced no alert, no DM, only a journalctl line nobody reads (a dead
smoke detector). It now emits a CRITICAL from source 'health_runner' naming the
check and exception, so the runner itself can't go quietly blind. (audit H3)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: fix(health): enforce predicted_vs_realized stat-power gates over the windows
commits.body:
n14 counted the whole 35-day lookback (not the 14d window) and min_days_28d was
never enforced anywhere, so early-season drift could fire CRITICAL on ~15 days
where the 14d and 28d windows overlap and the baseline isn't a real baseline.
Now both gates are measured over their windows: 14d >= min_days_14d AND 28d >=
min_days_28d. (audit)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: fix(health): streak_validation rejects boolean streak values
commits.body:
isinstance(True, int) is True, so a corrupt `"streak": true` validated as a
streak of 1. Reject bools explicitly (matches contest_state's type-is-int
discipline). (audit P3)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: fix(picks): atomic writes for pick + streak JSON (no torn-file crash-loop)
commits.body:
save_pick/save_shadow_pick/save_streak/save_pick_shadow used bare write_text: a
crash mid-write (deploy restarts are routine) could leave a truncated file that
then crashes every loader (check-results, reconcile, scheduler polling,
load_decision_streak_state) into a silent crash-loop the heartbeat monitor can't
see. New bts.util.atomic_write_text (tmp + fsync + os.replace) preserves each
caller's exact serialization; only the write is now atomic. (audit D1)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: fix(model): resolve platoon_hr pitcher hand at inference (was always NaN)
commits.body:
At the game_time-45min pick the live feed has no plays and the MLB schedule's
probablePitcher hydrate returns only {id,fullName,link} — no pitchHand (verified
against the live API; the audit's assumption that the hydrate carried it was
wrong). So slot['pitcher_hand'] was None for every production pick and platoon_hr
(a production FEATURE_COL) was silently NaN at inference while fully populated in
training/backtest. Now falls back to the pitcher's static handedness from history
(no leakage, no extra API call). (audit M1)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: fix(model): derive _fetch_prior_lineup schedule window from prediction year
commits.body:
The projected-lineup fallback hardcoded startDate=2026-03-20&endDate=2026-12-31,
so in 2027+ it would return the team's last 2026 regular-season lineup as the
'projected' lineup. Now takes season and scopes the window to int(date[:4]).
(audit M6)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: fix(model): average blend scores per slot, not per batter (doubleheaders)
commits.body:
blend_game_scores was keyed by batter_id only, so a batter playing both games of
a doubleheader had both game-rows' 12-model scores pooled into one mean and
mapped back to both rows — averaging two unrelated pitcher matchups and making
the DH pick selection tie on a wrong probability. Extracted _blend_average_by_slot
keyed by row; non-DH output is unchanged. (audit M5)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: fix(features): batter_hard_contact_30g leak-free (shadow CONTEXT col)
commits.body:
The feature rolled over PA rows (window=120, contradicting the _30g name) and
applied one .shift(1) across the whole batter-sorted series, so each batter's
first row inherited the previous batter's last value (cross-batter bleed) and
the post-shift window still held same-date PAs. Now date-aggregates then does
per-batter shift(1).rolling(30) and order-preserving left-merge, like every
other rolling feature. Shadow/CONTEXT only, but it contaminated the context-stack
promotion eval. (audit M4)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: fix(web): bind dashboard to the tailnet, never 0.0.0.0 by default (S2)
commits.body:
The dashboard bound 0.0.0.0:3003 with no app-layer auth; :3003 is firewalled
externally but a firewall change would silently expose pre-publication picks.
main() now binds the discovered Tailscale IPv4 (keeps http://bts-hetzner:3003
working), falling back to loopback — never 0.0.0.0. BTS_DASHBOARD_HOST overrides
(set it on the box to pin the tailnet IP, or 0.0.0.0 to deliberately expose).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: fix(scheduler): idle through no-games days instead of restart-thrashing
commits.body:
run_day returned immediately on an off-day; systemd Restart=always then
relaunched within ~30s and cycled all day (the All-Star break is ~4 days),
spiking NRestarts into a false restart_spike CRITICAL. Now computes a
guaranteed-future tomorrow wake (bumped past today on a multi-day break, which
compute_wakeup_time can't express) and idles via the existing
_idle_until_next_wakeup. (audit E1)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: harden(leaderboard): scrape resilience, username sanitize, drop UA email
commits.body:
- Schema drift (JSON/key/pydantic) on one tab or one user no longer aborts the
  whole scrape: parse moved inside the try and except broadened to log+continue
  (matches the 'one bad user won't abort' docstring it previously violated).
- Sanitize the arbitrary public username before using it as {username}.parquet
  (path-traversal write guard).
- Drop the real email from the outbound User-Agent (public repo); use the repo
  URL instead. (audit G)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: fix(contest_state): use model saver on fresh contest state when streaks agree
commits.body:
The MLB profile API can't observe the mulligan (contest saver always None),
which was pinned to False — making the saver-aware (higher-EV) MDP line at
streak 10-15 unreachable on the normal 4x/day fresh-contest path. Now falls back
to the locally-tracked model saver when the model streak agrees with the contest
streak (so it's a reliable proxy); stays conservative on divergence (e.g. a
manual override with a different streak). (audit D3)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: fix(contest_state): corrupt auto file can't block the manual override (D2)
commits.body:
load_contest_streak_state parsed BOTH contest files eagerly, so a corrupt auto
file raised before the precedence check and blocked a valid unexpired manual
override — the exact emergency the override exists to rescue. Now the override is
returned before the auto file is parsed. A corrupt manual file, or a corrupt auto
file with no active override, still fails closed (raises -> CRITICAL malformed).
(audit D2)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: harden(web,ci): audit-progress traversal guards + pin deploy action SHA
commits.body:
- /api/audit-progress confines dir to data/{provider}_results (rejects
  ..-/absolute traversal — it gates a root-SSH fan-out, not just an info leak)
  and seeds_file to the project root (rejects absolute/.. probing).
- Pin appleboy/ssh-action to its v1.2.5 commit SHA (it receives the root
  HETZNER_SSH_KEY; a moved floating tag could exfiltrate it). (audit G)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: fix(picks): reconcile recomputes streak by forward replay with saver (D4)
commits.body:
The nightly reconcile recomputed the streak with a BACKWARD walk that broke at
the first miss — it couldn't replay the saver (forgiveness depends on the forward
streak AT the miss being in [10,15] and whether the saver was already consumed),
so a saver-preserved streak was under-counted. Now forward-replays the season
via a saver state machine matching update_streak, and fails closed (keeps the
live streak.json) on incomplete/unreadable history rather than risk an
over-count. Validated against Codex's overcount traps. (audit D4)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: E2: make pick delivery idempotent (no double-post)
commits.body:
- retry_urlopen(idempotent=False): the 3 create-POSTs (post/reply/DM send) no
  longer retry on a lost response, which could re-send a committed request
- DailyPick.delivery_attempted: persisted before the network call, cleared on a
  caught failure; an uncaught crash leaves it set → _deliver_and_lock_pick
  refuses to re-send (a public-feed duplicate is worse than a missed post the
  EOD check surfaces). TDD: tests/test_e2_delivery_idempotency.py + test_util.py

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: Fix since_deploy_iso pick filter: compare instants, not ISO strings
commits.body:
run_time (+00:00) vs git %cI (committer-local offset) lexicographic compare
misclassifies picks across offsets. New _iso_before() compares tz-aware datetimes.
TDD: tests/health/test_since_deploy_iso_compare.py

NOTE (not fixed here — deeper, need deploy-time tracking): %cI is commit-time not
deploy-time, and a canary rollback moves HEAD's date backward so the rolled-back
model's picks pass the filter. Flagged for Eric.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: E3: implement the missed-pick early alert (was dead config)
commits.body:
If no pick is delivered by missed_pick_alert_min minutes before the earliest
first pitch, DM a one-shot warning (watchdog-fed wait to the alert window, then
re-check so a late delivery suppresses it) — the operator can post manually,
vs the hours-late EOD post_failure DM. Wired after the fallback section.
TDD: tests/test_e3_missed_pick_alert.py

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: H6: resurface a failed health DM on the next dispatch
commits.body:
When the prior health DM failed to send with CRITICALs, prepend a note to the
next DM so day-keyed one-shot CRITICALs aren't lost on a transient Bluesky
outage. Resurfaces even on an otherwise-clean day; cleared once it sends.
Gated on critical_count>0 (WARN-only failures don't resurface).
TDD: tests/health/test_h6_resurface.py

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: since_deploy_iso (2)+(3): use a real deploy-time stamp, not git commit-time
commits.body:
_current_deploy_iso now prefers data/.last_deploy_iso (wall-clock, monotonic) over
HEAD's %cI, fixing: (2) commit-time != deploy-time (picks made between commit and
deploy wrongly passed the filter), and (3) a canary rollback moving HEAD's date
backward (cutoff regressed → old-model picks re-included). deploy.yml writes the
stamp on a passed canary AND on rollback (forward-only). Falls back to %cI when the
stamp is absent — no regression. TDD: tests/health/test_deploy_iso_stamp.py

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
